verdict.line: You lose if you let him land a free Q (Decisive Strike) silence into full trade; you win almost every fight where you land E (Apprehend) first.

brief.thesis: Garen's entire kit is 300-325 range, while your E (Apprehend) reaches 535 — you can hook him before he can silence, spin, or flee. Once Apprehend lands, his only counter is a Q he's already burned to close distance, and your Hemorrhage stacks plus Decimate healing let you out-sustain his Perseverance regen through the whole fight. The 56.3% win rate over 245 games reflects a range and initiation mismatch, not a close skill matchup.

theirWindow.what: Perseverance is ticking and he can afford to eat a trade he'd otherwise lose. Land a Q (Decimate) edge-hit or auto first to shut off the regen before you commit further.

yourWindow.when: his Q (Decisive Strike) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: He has no gap-close, no silence, and no slow-cleanse for 8 seconds. This is your window to walk up and land E (Apprehend) from 535 range before he can react.

start.why: Wins 56.8% over 278 games and is picked 87.7% of the time in this matchup — the extra sustain and damage let you hold your ground through his early Judgment (E) pokes while you stack Hemorrhage faster.

boots.why: 55.7% win rate over 244 games and the standard pick (78%) — Garen's damage is entirely physical (Q bonus damage, W, E spin), so the flat reduction directly cuts his trade damage.

core.why: The active haste closes the gap to E range faster and adds burst before he can react, part of the highest-winrate path (63.3% over 30 games).
Builds momentum for chasing down his Q move-speed burst and adds HP to survive his sustained spin damage.
Completes the top build path at 63.3% win rate — the damage-over-time conversion lets your Hemorrhage bleeds and his own W/E damage tick past his Perseverance regen instead of bursting you down.

situational.when: you're getting focused or need a stronger all-in payoff instead of Death's Dance (75% win rate over 20 games in that path)
you want to prioritize mobility and wave clear over Youmuu's as your first core item (61.5% win rate over 13 games)
the enemy team stacks magic damage alongside Garen

runes.keystoneWhy: Ramps damage and healing through extended fights, which matters most in this matchup since your E-initiated trades run long and you need the adaptive force/healing to outlast Perseverance ticks. Runs 54.8% win rate at 30.5% pick, the standard choice.

summoners.why: Flash+Ghost is both the highest win rate (58.2%) and most-picked combo (63.8%) in this matchup — Ghost closes the distance to land E even faster and helps you stick through his Q move-speed burst. Flash+Ignite (53.3%, 30.3% pick) is the alternative if you want a harder guaranteed kill threat with R (Noxian Guillotine) pre-6.

playing.title: Lead every fight with E
playing.detail: Apprehend's 535 range beats his Q (300) and E (325) outright — pull him in before he can silence or spin, don't wait for him to approach first.

playing.title: Stack Hemorrhage before R
playing.detail: Noxian Guillotine's true damage scales per Hemorrhage stack on him, so land Q (Decimate) and autos first to maximize the execute rather than R'ing on cooldown.

playing.title: Hit the Decimate blade, not the handle
playing.detail: Only the blade edge gives full damage and the champion-hit heal — swing so he's caught on the outer edge rather than standing in the weaker inner handle zone.

playing.title: All-in only after his Q is spent
playing.detail: Once Decisive Strike is on its 8s cooldown he has no slow-cleanse or gap-close left — that's your green light to commit fully.

playing.title: Poke before you engage
playing.detail: If he hasn't taken damage recently, Perseverance is healing him a percentage of his health every second — land a Decimate edge or autos first to shut that off before going for the kill.

playing.title: Time W after his Q, not before
playing.detail: Crippling Strike's slow gets cleansed instantly if he still has Decisive Strike up, so land it after he's already used Q to actually stick the slow.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, rune, and summoner data are measured from live games on the current patch (16.18.1) via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning behind the trade patterns and timings is my own analysis, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Maintain your passive stacks and hit Garen at the edge of Decimate [Q]. Use [E] whenever he stands in range to fight him.
